[Local News] {DATE}

{P1.job} {P1} announced on Tuesday that bus service will expand to the {PLACE} district next spring. Speaking at a press conference held at {ORG}, the {P1.job} described the plan as the first step in a three-year transport program.

The proposal adds 14 new routes and extends evening hours on existing lines. Funding will come from municipal bonds and a federal grant that has not yet been formally approved.

Opposition members questioned the cost estimate, and a council vote is expected in November. The full budget will be presented at the next public hearing.

MINUTES OF THE QUALITY COMMITTEE

Date: {DATE}
Venue: Room 4, Building 2

Attendees:
{P1} ({P1.org}, {P1.job})
{P2} ({P2.dept})

Moderator: {P3}

Item 1: Review of the March audit findings. The committee confirmed that two of the four findings are closed. The remaining two will be checked again at the next meeting.

Item 2: Training schedule for new inspection staff. The first session will be held in the second week of next month.

Next meeting: {DATE}
Minutes prepared by the secretariat.

{P1} works as a {P1.job} at {P1.org} starting Monday, and I am so happy for them. Two years of applications and a lot of coffee later, it finally happened lol #newjob #finallyyes

↳ {P2.handle}: Congrats!! Your portfolio was the reason they said yes, you know that. Drinks this Friday?
